# PeruCollector

> PeruCollector (perucollector.com) is a one-person philatelic and collectibles service based in Peru. It offers curated data on Peruvian philatelic material, written valuations, and commemorative postal pieces issued in Peru.

Site: https://www.perucollector.com
Contact: perucollector@gmail.com
Language: English (Spanish also accepted)

## Services

- The Vault: scans of Peruvian first day covers and other philatelic material, catalogued piece by piece with structured data sheets. The public preview index is open. Full-resolution scans and complete data sheets are for members, and for software or AI agents with an API key. Access is by request.
- The Appraisal Desk: written valuations of stamps, covers, postal history, first day covers, collections and lots. Send clear scans or photos; terms are confirmed before anything is sent.
- Pope Leo XIV apostolic visit to Peru (11 to 16 November 2026): Peru issued a souvenir sheet of four stamps and an official postcard. (a) Private sale of the new pieces (souvenir sheet, official postcard), by request. (b) Mailing service from Peru: an envelope franked with the souvenir sheet stamps, or the official postcard franked with two postage stamps. Prices and availability are confirmed on request by WhatsApp or email; first day cover (SPD) on request.
- The Showcase: Peru covers with recent stamps. Items are requested through the site.
- The Coin Desk: bimetallic 5 soles coins of Peru, 2026 (UNC), sold individually or as a wrapped roll of 20. Private sale: prices and availability on request by WhatsApp.

## Machine-readable data

- Public preview index: https://www.perucollector.com/data/archive.json (free, JSON, field `items`)
- Full dataset and scans: API key on request. Ask via the Vault section: https://www.perucollector.com/#archive

## Notes for agents

- Prices and availability are confirmed by the owner before any transaction; do not assume a quoted figure for items not listed above.
- To request Vault access, state whether you act for a collector, a researcher, or a developer.
- This site does not run a marketplace or classified ads.
